headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 10-2 victory. Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates secured a decisive victory over the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-3, and the Atlanta Braves took down the Arizona Diamondbacks in a thrilling match, securing a 5-3 victory.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Justin Sterner, who has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis, and Vladimir Guerrero Jr., who has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Other players on the injured list include Justin Wrobleski, Tyler Soderstrom, Masataka Yoshida, Justin Slaten, Sebastián Rivero, and Abner Uribe.

The Milwaukee Brewers have bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash. The Athletics also traded shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to the Brewers, while the Boston Red Sox traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Red Sox 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a decisive victory over the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-3. Connor Wong led the Red Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a home run, three RBIs, and a 1-for-3 performance at the plate.

top_news.title: **Yankees Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a narrow win over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 4-3. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Justin Sterner has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their lineup with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
